best_for: Silver-tone watch on a steel bracelet
verdict: A silver-tone watch on a stainless steel bracelet, from Timex's Transcend range.
paragraphs: The Timex India listing gives a 34 mm round case that is 6.5 mm thick, a silver-tone dial and a stainless steel bracelet. The glass is mineral glass and the movement is quartz analog.
The case is low-lead brass. The listing gives 30 m water resistance and a one-year warranty against manufacturer defects.
The listing gives a wrist-size range of 150 to 205 mm.
good: 6.5 mm case thickness, per the listing
Stainless steel bracelet, per the listing
Mineral glass cover, per the listing
1 year warranty against manufacturer defects, per Timex India
not_good: The listing does not name a light or any extra features
The listing gives only "30m" for water resistance
